# test_factorial.py
import pytest

from your_module import factorial  # replace with the actual module name


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("n", "expected"),
    [
        (0, 1),   # edge case: 0!
        (1, 1),   # edge case: 1!
        (2, 2),
        (3, 6),
        (5, 120),
        (10, 3628800),
    ],
)
def test_factorial_known_values(n, expected):
    assert factorial(n) == expected


def test_factorial_larger_value():
    assert factorial(20) == 2432902008176640000


@pytest.mark.parametrize("n", [-1, -2, -100])
def test_factorial_negative_input_raises_value_error(n):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="n must be non-negative"):
        factorial(n)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("bad_input", [None, "5", [], {}, object()])
def test_factorial_unsupported_input_types_raise_type_error(bad_input):

        factorial(bad_input)
